params.name: stream_chunk_policy
params.description: Streaming codec chunk schedule: grow starts with one frame and doubles to stream_frames_per_event; fixed uses that size throughout.

params.name: stream_frames_per_event
params.description: Codec frames per fixed streaming event, or the maximum for growing events. Smaller values reduce chunk latency but increase decoding overhead.

params.name: language
params.description: Target synthesis language code or label; default auto lets the model infer from text and voice settings.

params.name: max_tokens
params.description: Maximum generated codec frames per text chunk; omitted uses the checkpoint generation_config.json (2048 when absent).

params.name: do_sample
params.description: Sample the main codec stream instead of greedy decoding; default true.

params.name: temperature
params.description: Main codec sampling temperature; must be > 0 when do_sample=true. Ignored when do_sample=false; default 0.9.

params.name: top_k
params.description: Main codec top-k sampling limit; default 50, 0 disables top-k filtering.

params.name: top_p
params.description: Main codec nucleus sampling limit; default 1.0.

params.name: repetition_penalty
params.description: Main codec repetition penalty; must be > 0, default 1.05.

params.name: subtalker_do_sample
params.description: Enable subtalker sampling for the remaining audio codebooks instead of greedy decoding; default true.

params.name: subtalker_temperature
params.description: Subtalker sampling temperature; must be > 0 when subtalker_do_sample=true. Ignored when subtalker_do_sample=false; default 0.9.

params.name: subtalker_top_k
params.description: Subtalker top-k sampling limit; default 50, 0 disables top-k filtering.

params.name: seed
params.description: Codec sampling seed; omitted requests choose a random seed.

params.name: reference_text
params.description: Transcript matching the reference audio for voice cloning; required unless x_vector_only_mode=true.

params.name: x_vector_only_mode
params.description: Use only the speaker embedding for voice cloning instead of ICL reference codec prompting; default false.

params.name: instruct
params.description: Optional natural-language voice or style instruction for VoiceDesign and CustomVoice variants; empty instructions are accepted.

params.name: voice_id
params.description: Named preset speaker from the CustomVoice checkpoint. Legacy speaker remains accepted.

params.name: text_chunk_size
params.description: Maximum UTF-8 codepoints per long-form text chunk; default 8192.
